items.title: How to prepare for the proposed HIPAA Security Rule update with AWS Backup and the HIPAA Assistant
items.summary: In this post, we summarize what HHS has proposed, when it is likely to matter, and how to use Amazon Web Services (AWS) to close the gaps now. We cover how AWS Backup maps to the three proposed backup and recovery obligations, and we introduce the HIPAA Assistant, an open source sample from AWS that reviews your infrastructure-as-code and application code for Security Rule gaps and cites each finding to the exact paragraph of the regulation.
items.creator: Harshvardhan Chunawala
